decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the floor-care range that gained its own web page by 2024, it shows visible commitment and enough strategic fit that management would continue backing it.

Even without a dedicated page, this maintenance oil complements the installed flooring base and supports the firm's full-system offer, making management inclined to persist rather than admit a weak launch.
Because it received its own page by 2024 and strengthens the aftercare portfolio for oiled floors, management would see it as a committed and still promising line to retain.
This underlay fits the firm's technical installation offer and helps sell complete flooring solutions, so management would likely keep it and attribute any limited traction to normal market build-up.
As another installation accessory closely tied to the core flooring business, it benefits from bundling logic and low reputational cost of continuing, which favors persistence.
An oak parquet floor is close to the firm's manufacturing core and likely carries higher sunk investment and strategic importance, so management would be especially reluctant to withdraw it.
